superseded_reason: The central oracle-selected context was incorrectly labelled central RAG. No model had run.
hypothesis: When no pocket i has the complete answer, a minimal human-readable harness can preserve and combine distributed evidence at least as well as a central RAG and better than unstructured pocket-i messages.

conditions.description: One shared Qwen receives the three selected raw documents in one central context.
The same three pocket i read only their own local document and send unrestricted text to the final Qwen.
The same three pocket i send a small claim-and-evidence capsule; the final Qwen may use only supported capsule claims.

minimal_capsule.source: one local document id or null
minimal_capsule.quote: one exact supporting quote or null
minimal_capsule.missing: what is still unknown or null

harness_rules: A claim without a source and exact quote is rejected before final assembly.
The final answer may not add a factual claim absent from accepted capsules.
A not_found capsule is preserved as missing knowledge, not converted into a guess.
The harness does not rank sources, remove shared lineages, resolve conflicts, or route experts in this first stage.

generation.weights: same frozen local checkpoint used by every condition

evaluation.semantic_review: blind review required for all 30 final answers

claim_boundary: This ten-question English-only development experiment can discover useful harness rules. It cannot prove population-scale swarm intelligence, privacy, routing quality, multilingual transfer, or statistical significance.
